import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date']=pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
keys=['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family','price','num_instances','expiration_date']
# rows around the anomaly date for each instance_family: price and num_instances changes
p = df.pivot_table(index=keys, columns='date', values='unblended_cost', aggfunc='sum')
base = p.loc[:, :'2025-10-18'].mean(axis=1)
after = p.loc[:, '2025-10-20':].mean(axis=1)
on = p['2025-10-20'].fillna(0)
prev = p['2025-10-19'].fillna(0)
out = pd.DataFrame({'base':base,'d19':prev,'d20':on,'after':after})
out['delta_vs_base']=out['after']-out['base']
out['delta20_vs_base']=out['d20']-out['base']
print(out.reindex(out['delta_vs_base'].abs().sort_values(ascending=False).index).head(20).to_string())

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date']=pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
agg = df.groupby(['instance_family','date']).agg(cost=('unblended_cost','sum'),price=('price','mean'),n=('num_instances','mean'),nprices=('price','nunique'),nn=('num_instances','nunique')).reset_index()
p = agg.pivot_table(index='instance_family',columns='date',values='cost')
base = p.loc[:, :'2025-10-18'].mean(axis=1)
on = p['2025-10-20'].fillna(0)
prev = p['2025-10-19'].fillna(0)
after = p.loc[:, '2025-10-20':].mean(axis=1)
res = pd.DataFrame({'base':base,'d19':prev,'d20':on,'after':after})
res['step']=after-base
res['jump20']=on-base
print(res.sort_values('step',ascending=False).head(12).to_string())
print(res.sort_values('step').head(8).to_string())
print(res.sort_values('jump20',ascending=False).head(12).to_string())

df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

    print(fam)

for c in chg: print(c)

print(df[df.num_instances>10].groupby(['instance_family','num_instances'])['date'].agg(['min','max','count']).to_string())
print('\nDistinct num_instances values:', sorted(df.num_instances.unique()))
print('\nCost delta decomposition on 2025-10-20 vs trailing 7d mean, by family:')
p=df.pivot_table(index='instance_family',columns='date',values='unblended_cost',aggfunc='sum').fillna(0)
b=p.loc[:,'2025-10-13':'2025-10-19'].mean(axis=1)
d=(p['2025-10-20']-b).sort_values(ascending=False)
print(d.head(8).to_string())
print('total delta', (p['2025-10-20']-b).sum())

import pandas as pd
df=pd.read_csv('data.csv'); df['date']=pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
for fam in ['GWymgjl2rF','wXs6GRnJz0']:
    s=df[df.instance_family==fam].sort_values('date').copy()
    s['price_change']=s.price.ne(s.price.shift())
    s['instances_change']=s.num_instances.ne(s.num_instances.shift())
    print(fam, 'context:', s[['cloud_service','application']].iloc[0].to_dict())
    print(s[s.price_change | ((s.num_instances>10)&s.instances_change)][['date','price','num_instances','unblended_cost']].to_string(index=False))
    b=s[s.date<'2025-10-20'].tail(7).unblended_cost.mean()
    print('Oct 20 cost:',s.loc[s.date.eq('2025-10-20'),'unblended_cost'].iloc[0], 'prior-7d mean:',b)
print('\nCXGOJ39RZm (recurring 21-instance pattern, for contrast):')
s=df[df.instance_family=='CXGOJ39RZm']
print(s[s.num_instances>10][['date','price','num_instances','unblended_cost']].to_string(index=False))
